title: unified-rollouts: proactive shadow + canary AB autorollback enhancements
author: Lydia Park
description: Add proactive probing and safety heuristics to unified rollouts to improve canary + shadow AB deployments and reduce false positives for automatic rollback. This patch implements: (1) lightweight staged shadow probing that exercises new model variants with synthetic and sampled traffic before promoting to canary; (2) multi-metric matching and hysteresis in the autorollback controller to avoid flip-flop during transient anomalies; (3) configurable probing schedules and early-abort windows exposed via rollout policy; (4) new observability spans and metrics to surface probing success/failure rates, probe latency, and matching confidence. Motivation: we observed noisy rollbacks during high traffic bursts (INC-2026-001) where short-lived latency spikes triggered autorollback despite stable quality signals. Proactive probing detects fragile model variants earlier and the hysteresis reduces churn. This change is backwards-compatible by default (existing rollout policies keep current behavior). Included e2e tests for staged shadow probing and unit tests for matching logic. Checklist: - [x] Design doc link (Linear: ENG-2719) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Observability dashboards updated - [x] Feature gated behind rollout flag - [x] Performance impact validated on perf-canary cluster
